run_prep_wav_list: run a script that reads WAV file paths from a source list and outputs paths with sample counts to a destination file
create_wav_sample_count_list: create a tab-separated list of WAV file paths and their sample counts from a source file
build_wav_metadata_extractor: build a tool that extracts the number of audio samples from each WAV file in a list
refactor_wav_list_processor: refactor the WAV list processor to handle additional audio metadata beyond sample counts
review_wav_list_prep: review the script that reads WAV files and writes their paths with sample counts to a destination file
